max.evidence: On Anthropic's own charts Opus 5.5 at max scores at most 1.8 points above high on Terminal-Bench 4.0, FrontierCode and CursorBench for 2.9 to 5.7 times the cost per task; Sonnet 5.5 at max scores 46.2% on FrontierCode against 52.1% at xhigh for 13 times the cost and more often splits a review across subagents of its own; in Anthropic's effort post one build took 79 minutes at max against 33 at high.
